title: Cleartext legacy protocol (ftp) — review required
description: Code uses a cleartext legacy protocol or library: (?:^|[^a-zA-Z])(?:tftp|ftp)://[A-Za-z0-9] (ftp). FTP and Telnet send credentials and data without protection. This lexical rule flags the use; the reviewer confirms isolation or migrates it.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the use regardless of network isolation.
